unbroken_blade.name: Path of the Unbroken Blade
unbroken_blade.blurb: Steel will and decisive strikes — the dao of the sword.
unbroken_blade.ceremony: A phantom blade hums at your wrist; combat flows come easier to hand.
unbroken_blade.stat_note: Blade path: +5% hunt and adventure success.

still_lotus.name: Path of the Still Lotus
still_lotus.blurb: Rooted qi and patient defense — the dao of the shield.
still_lotus.ceremony: Lotus light settles in your dantian; your meridians resist disruption.
still_lotus.stat_note: Lotus path: +3 starting qi and a qi-gathering pill.

wandering_star.name: Path of the Wandering Star
wandering_star.blurb: Starlight and long breaths — the dao of steady cultivation.
wandering_star.ceremony: A star-mark flickers on your palm; qi gathers when you rest.
wandering_star.stat_note: Star path: +8% cultivate qi for your first sessions.

hidden_ledger.name: Path of the Hidden Ledger
hidden_ledger.blurb: Secrets, karma, and winding roads — the dao of the wanderer.
hidden_ledger.ceremony: Hidden lines trace your fate; the world watches how you choose.
hidden_ledger.stat_note: Ledger path: +spirit stones and a technique fragment.
